caption: The drawing features three outlines of a shoe on a plain, beige background. Two of these outlines are positioned in the upper left section of the paper: one shows a top view of the shoe with a bow or buckle detail at the front and a thin strap that crosses over, while the other is a side view of the same shoe, emphasizing its elongated form. The third and largest outline is located in the lower right quadrant, showing a more detailed side view of the shoe, including the same bow or buckle detail and the thin strap, which extends outward from the shoe. All outlines are rendered in a light gray pencil, and the drawing does not include any shading, solid colors, or background elements apart from the unadorned surface of the paper.
title: Slipper
